title: the hall of doors
caption: You have been walking a while. You do not remember starting.

hotspots.label: A door with dusk leaking around its edges
A door that is warm to the touch
hotspots.text: Warm. Warmer than a door should be. It does not open.
hotspots.hint: Heat. Something on the other side is burning, or cooking, or alive and enormous. A furnace room, a kitchen at the end of the world, the inside of a sleeping animal.

hotspots.label: A door with far too many hinges
hotspots.text: Eight hinges. You count them twice and get nine.
hotspots.hint: A door built to open in a direction you do not have. Behind it: a room with inconsistent geometry, or a folding place, or the same hall again but wrong.

hotspots.label: A door standing slightly ajar, green light in the crack
A door with no handle on this side
hotspots.text: No handle. Not stuck — simply not built to be opened from here.
hotspots.hint: Should open only from the far side. This is the natural EXIT of a future region, discovered from behind. Build the region first, then link back through here.

hotspots.label: A very small door, low in the wall
hotspots.text: It comes up to your knee. There is a light on under it.
hotspots.hint: Scale. Behind it: somewhere built for something small, drawn at a scale that makes the player feel enormous. A lit room, occupied, tidy.

hotspots.label: The door at the end of the hall
hotspots.text: The door at the end of the hall, which is always the same distance away.
hotspots.hint: Should never actually open. A late-game payoff at most. If a future run wants to use it, the reward is a corridor identical to this one with a single detail changed.

hotspots.label: The nearest hanging lamp
hotspots.text: The lamp swings. Nothing here is moving air.

hotspots.label: The carpet running the length of the hall
hotspots.text: Something passes underneath the carpet, from one end of the hall to the other.
